fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (contradiction on daemon-picks-backlog): The new default (backlog = "after", used with no policy.toml) contradicts two landed testscripts that no leaf of the plan names. (1) cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-picks.txtar accepts a 'Backlog' change set with a leaf serving no milestone, then polls with --min-free 0 under the default max-runs 2 and expects exactly one 'Started a run of' (stdout -count=1, around lines 64-70). Under 'after' the Backlog change set would also start. (2) cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-status-projects.txtar (capability daemon-status-across-projects) expects each project's accepted no-milestone 'Orphan' to be skipped with reason no-milestone / 'serves no milestone' (lines 73-82). Under the default it would be picked. daemon-picks-backlog's acceptance covers only daemon_picks_test.go, and daemon-status-skips covers only daemon-status.txtar. A leaf's acceptance should say how these two scripts change (set backlog = "skip" in their repos, or expect the backlog pick). The critic confirmed it: No leaf's acceptance names daemon-picks.txtar or daemon-status-projects.txtar (daemon-status-skips names only daemon-status.txtar, daemon-picks-backlog only daemon_picks_test.go and a new testscript). In daemon-picks.txtar the Backlog change set has a leaf (backlog-leaf), serves only the non-milestone intent plain and is accepted; with no policy.toml and the default max-runs of 2, the 20 GiB poll expects stdout -count=1 '^Started a run of ', which fails once Backlog is picked under the default after. daemon-status-projects.txtar expects each project's accepted, leafed Orphan skipped with reason no-milestone / 'serves no milestone', which the default also turns into a pick. The plan contradicts these landed scripts without saying how they change. How should it be settled?
